meta.title: Project INSPYR: student-led volunteering and stories from Pune
meta.description: A student-led team from Pune that volunteers with NGOs and service organizations, then turns their work into short films people actually watch.
meta.ogTitle: We show up. Then we tell the [[story]].

hero.valueProp: Project INSPYR is a team of students in Pune who volunteer alongside NGOs and service organizations, then turn that work into short films people actually stop scrolling for.

bridge.title: The bridge
bridge.body: Organizations doing the work on one side. The public on the other. We carry the spark across.

whatWeDo.title: Two ways we close the [[gap]].
whatWeDo.bubble: They call us the future. We would rather start now.
whatWeDo.intro: Good work happens across Pune every day. Most of it goes unseen. We work on both sides of that problem.

pillars.title: Hands-on volunteering
pillars.body: We turn up in person at drives, events and on-ground days. Extra hands first, cameras second. It is how we learn what the work really takes.

pillars.title: Stories that travel
pillars.body: We script, shoot and edit reels and shorts about the organizations we work with, built for Instagram and YouTube, where our generation already is.

steps.title: Connect
steps.body: Tell us who you are and what you are working on. A short message or call is enough to start.

steps.title: We show up
steps.body: Our team volunteers with you on the ground, learns how your work actually runs, and films as we go.

steps.title: We tell your story
steps.body: We cut it into a short reel built to be watched and shared, and publish it on our channels with you credited.

paragraphs: They call us the future. We would rather {{start now}}.
We are students. No titles, no budgets, no permission slips. What we do have is time, cameras in our pockets, and a generation that scrolls past a thousand things a day.
Right now, somewhere in Pune, someone is serving meals, teaching a class nobody funds, or caring for people the rest of the city walks past. Most of it will never be seen.
The problem was never a shortage of good people. It is a shortage of people [[paying attention]].
So we pick a side. We show up, we do the work with them, and we make sure the city sees it. We are just getting started.

reels.title: Short films, [[real]] work.
reels.intro: Reels and shorts, one to three minutes each, about the people and organizations we work with.
reels.emptyBody: This is where our best reels will live. Until they land here, the full feed is on Instagram.

cards.title: The public
cards.body: See what is actually happening in your city. Watch, share, and find out where a spare afternoon can help.

cards.title: Sponsors & donors
cards.body: Back student energy with real reach. Support the work, and get credited in the stories it creates.

cards.title: Students
cards.body: You do not need a title to start. Volunteer with us, bring your school along, and learn to tell stories that matter.

impact.title: Numbers, [[honestly]] counted.
impact.intro: We only post what we can count. These fill in as the work does.

closing.title: Got work worth [[seeing]]?
closing.body: Whether you run a service organization, want to back one, or want to get your hands dirty, there is a place for you on this bridge.
